notes: «أبی ره» is the compiler's own father, named only by relation (relation kind); «ره» is left out
«يرفعه إلى» is the gap before أبی عبد الله (rule 8): unnamed, in its place in the order
أبی عبد الله is named inside the chain after «إلى», so he is a narrator link, not imam_in_text; «قال» introduces his words
